summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would prohibit Commonwealth, state and territory authorities from using or disclosing government COVID-19 check-in app data for enforcement activities, including policing and surveillance.
The restriction would cover information about people collected or generated through those apps, including data obtained indirectly and information recorded before the legislation began.
It would begin the day after royal assent, with exceptions for de-identified statistics and information obtained from sources independent of check-in apps.
changes: Authorities would be barred from using covered check-in information to investigate offences or enforce penalties.
Disclosure of covered data for enforcement activities would also be prohibited.
The legislation would bind the Crown in every capacity.
summary.affected: People using government check-in apps, police, other enforcement bodies and Commonwealth, state and territory authorities holding covered data would be affected.
